role: Adaptive development-only extension; not part of the original search protocol and not an independent confirmation.
reason: Development audit shows employer-like frequent emp_title values in 2012 and job-title-like values in 2014. Early CV context ablation reduced LightGBM AP by 0.0110 on average. This motivates, but does not prove, temporal heterogeneity of this feature group.
observed_before_extension: V3 LightGBM ablations and joint search
V3 CatBoost baseline AP early-stopping trial
development context availability, top values and unseen-category rates
control_rule: Exact V2 CatBoost parameters, 1177 iterations, seed42, 36-month training since2012 throughJune2014, all215847rows, native preparation, no recency weights. Change only the declared feature group. Evaluate the same complete40595 Q3rows.
extra_blends: For each of the two controls, blend with unchanged V2 Q3 CatBoost at V2 weights0.25,0.50,0.75. No additional fitting or weights learned from2015/16.
selection_rule_unchanged: Highest raw AP on the identical Q3 development cohort; retain all prior candidates and all negative results.
interpretation: Adaptive expansion increases development selection optimism. Preserve the negative early-CV evidence, report temporal heterogeneity, and freeze before new benchmark predictions. No further choice based on2015/16.
